# IntraMed Solution

> IntraMed Solution is a Lahore, Pakistan based supplier of disposable, single-use medical devices for hospitals and clinics across Pakistan, specializing in gastroenterology (gastro), cardiology, and peripheral vascular devices.

IntraMed Solution supplies sterile, single-use surgical devices for three core specialities:
- Gastroenterology / gastro devices — ERCP guide wires, sphincterotomes, biopsy & grasping forceps, hemostatic clips, PEG feeding sets.
- Cardiology devices — cath-lab diagnostic catheters, angioplasty & stenting devices, guidewires, hemostasis & vascular access devices.
- Vascular devices — access sheaths, peripheral guidewires, diagnostic angiography catheters, interventional balloon catheters.

All products are sterile, single-use, and supplied to hospitals, clinics, cath-labs, endoscopy units and interventional radiology / vascular surgery centers across Lahore and nationwide Pakistan, with same-day / next-day delivery in Lahore and 2-3 day delivery nationwide.

Contact: 0346 4711440 | info@intramedsolution.com | Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan
